# Krain Studio

> Krain Studio is a freelance architectural-technology studio in Biggleswade, Bedfordshire (UK), producing RIBA Stage 4 and Stage 5 packages — construction-stage drawings, technical details, schedules and specifications — plus independent drawing-package review for architects, developers, contractors and private clients across the UK.

We turn a design-stage scheme into a coordinated, buildable construction package. We produce Stage 4 (technical design) and Stage 5 (manufacturing & construction) drawings and details, and we review other teams' drawing sets for missing information, coordination errors and buildability risk before they reach site. We are a technical/production studio — we pick up where the design architect leaves off and make the set ready to build. We do not replace the architect, structural engineer, Building Control body or warranty provider.

Contact: matt@krain.studio. Based in Biggleswade, Bedfordshire; working with project teams across the UK.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.krain.studio/services): Technical CAD production, construction details, Stage 4/5 documentation, drawing audits and site-query support
- [Drawing review & technical audit](https://www.krain.studio/services#review): Independent check of a drawing package for missing references, coordination gaps and buildability risk
